thread:
deploy-bot: Quickcheck alert for release v3.4.1 -> us-west canary (5%). Probe 'embed-smoke-fast' failed threshold: p95=510ms (baseline 160ms), errors=2.9% (baseline 0.2%). Rule: fail if errors>1% or p95>300ms. See runbook: https://runbooks/release-smoke. @sre-oncall @tara

tara: Thanks. Which hosts are affected?

deploy-bot: Affected hosts: i-0f12ab3c, i-0c98d7e6, i-0b44aa99. Failures are 502/upstream timeouts.

leo: I pulled logs — proxy returns 502 before request reaches model. Model GPU traces show normal latency. Suspect proxy FD pressure or thread exhaustion.

miles: We flipped a small runtime tweak earlier (kv prefill). That should be runtime-only, not proxy. Still, pause rollout and route canary traffic back to v3.4.0 until we confirm.

sre-oncall: Agreed. Pause now. Guard: if aggregated errors >2% for 10m, perform full rollback.

tara: Kicking off targeted synths against the three hosts with header X-Canary:1: `./tools/synth --probe embed-smoke-fast --hosts i-0f12ab3c,i-0c98d7e6,i-0b44aa99 --count 120 --header "X-Canary:1"`

leo: Snapshots show Max open files=1024 and current FD usage ~980 on i-0f12ab3c. That's probably it.

miles: Plan: graceful restart of inference-proxy per host (disable serving, restart, reenable), and add LimitNOFILE bump to infra backlog. Do restarts one-at-a-time.

sre-oncall: +1. Do not change systemd limits live. Restart sequence only.

tara: Restarting proxy on i-0f12ab3c (graceful). Will collect before/after `lsof -p $(pidof inference-proxy) | wc -l` and `ss -tanp | grep ESTAB | wc -l`.

deploy-bot: Action: rollout paused at 5% (action by miles). Rerouted canary traffic for affected allocation to v3.4.0 at 6509876570.

leo: Restart done on i-0f12ab3c. Post-restart synth: failures dropped from 12/120 -> 1/120. Good.

tara: Restarted second host i-0c98d7e6 -> 0/120 failures.

miles: After two restarts aggregated canary error is 0.5%. Keeping rollout paused for 20m stability window, then resume slow ramp to 25% if stable.

sre-oncall: I'll add a preflight check to deploy-bot: require open file limit >=8192 on proxy hosts before permitting canary routing. Also logging this decision. :white_check_mark:

leo: Uploading logs to /artifacts/releases/v3.4.1/proxy-fd-restart-6509876543.tar.gz

tara: I'll add a one-liner to the release notes: "v3.4.1: paused canary routing due to proxy upstream timeouts; mitigated by targeted proxy restarts; follow-up: increase LimitNOFILE and add FD preflight checks."

sre-oncall: Thread archived for now; reopen if quickcheck breaches thresholds or errors spike. Ping @sre-oncall to escalate.
